sections.title: MPA Internship
sections.description: Internship with a relevant nonprofit or government agency, chosen in consultation with a career services advisor. Students put their knowledge to use, develop vital skills, and build a professional network through an internship with a government or nonprofit organization. Our career advising team helps students identify internship opportunities to align with their professional goals.
